prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select Companion Breed"]
1: ["Your pet engine is generating animations.", "Crafting Your Desktop Pet", "We are setting up your pet's desktop behaviors and custom animations.", "Generating desktop assets", "Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to bring up quick controls."]
2: ["Quick Desktop Controls Practice", "Try out these simple controls to finish onboarding.", "1. Click pet to interact | 2. Right-click tray to hide | 3. Drag to reposition", "Complete Practice"]
3: ["Sign In & Restore Your Pets", "Sign in with your registered account to instantly restore saved pets and certificates.", "Sync Saved Pets & Data", "Sign In & Restore"]
4: ["Not sure? Choose Preset Friend to jump right in with a ready-made pet design."]
5: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We will alert you the second your pet is ready."]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use well-lit, front-facing photos with clear contrast for best 2D generation results.", "Avoid dark or blurry photos to ensure generation succeeds."]
7: ["Starter Pack Unlocked: Free Toy & Certificate"]
8: ["Screen taking long to load? Check your network connection or try an alternate sign-in option."]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give Your Pet a Name", "Sign Certificate & Finish"]
